verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. The evidence does not show it. The Windows App SDK and Windows AI APIs are developer building blocks for building apps, not an API that exposes everything the Windows UI can do. The PowerShell probe only shows that an official CLI exists and makes no parity claim. No OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
